name: Low-Carb Chipotle Honey Chicken Tenders
desc: Air-fried chicken tenders in low-carb crumbs, tossed in a spicy-sweet chipotle honey and lime sauce.

source.title: Low-Carb Chipotle Honey Chicken Tenders
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 cup low-carb breadcrumbs (almond flour crumbs, crushed pork rinds, or regular breadcrumbs)
ingredients.note: almond flour crumbs, crushed pork rinds, or regular breadcrumbs

ingredients.raw: 2-3 tbsp adobo sauce (from a can of chipotles in adobo)
ingredients.note: from a can of chipotles in adobo

steps: Whisk the eggs in a shallow bowl. In a second bowl, mix the breadcrumbs, 1 tsp chipotle powder, salt and pepper.
Dip each tender in egg, then press into the crumbs to coat.
Arrange in a single layer, spray lightly with oil, and air fry 12 minutes. Flip, spray again, and air fry 3-5 minutes more, until golden and 165°F inside.
Meanwhile, combine the honey, adobo sauce, lime juice, 1/2 tsp chipotle powder and garlic powder in a small saucepan and simmer over low heat, stirring, for 1 minute.
Toss the tenders in the sauce or spoon it over, and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Serve with ranch or blue cheese for dipping.
tips: The caption's method mixes paprika into the crumbs while the ingredient list says chipotle powder; either works.

The caption does not give an air fryer temperature or mention oil spray; 390°F with a light spray is what Razzle Dazzle Life uses for breaded honey chipotle tenders on the same 10 plus 5 minute schedule.

references.title: Honey Chipotle Air Fry Chicken Tenders
references.usedFor: 390°F air fryer temperature, spraying the breaded tenders, short low simmer for the sauce
